#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

bool is_valid(const vector<int>& f, int p, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int count_f_arrays(vector<int>& f, int p, int k, int position) {
    if (position == p) {
        return is_valid(f, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    int total = 0;
    for (int val = 0; val < p; ++val) {
        f.push_back(val);
        total += count_f_arrays(f, p, k, position + 1);
        f.pop_back();
    }
    return total;
}

long long calculate(int p, int k) {
    int group_count = 0;
    set<int> visited;
    for (int start = 0; start < p; ++start) {
        if (visited.find(start) == visited.end()) {
            group_count++;
        }
        int current = start;
        while (visited.find(current) == visited.end()) {
            visited.insert(current);
            current = (current * k) % p;
        }
    }
    long long mod = 1000000007;
    long long exponent = group_count - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
    long long result = 1;
    for (long long i = 0; i < exponent; ++i) {
        result = (result * p) % mod;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << calculate(p, k) << endl;
    return 0;
}
